_comment: === C13 SPLIT-FORM COUNTEREXAMPLE (matches paper Lemma lem:c13_split_limit) ===
1 aircraft, check type A only, T_A_max = 600 min (10h).
Flight 1: tiny day-1 trigger flight at M (duration 10 min) -> mega[0,1,'A']=1.
Flight 3: 600-min flight on day 4, arriving at M -> mega[0,4,'A']=1 (v4=600).
No check on days 2/3. Endpoint-split C13 relaxes both rows for window (1,4)
because BOTH endpoints (day 1 and day 4) carry a check, even though 1200
minutes are flown strictly between those two checks (v2+v4=1200 > 600).
See experiments/c13_loophole_validation.py for the numeric verification.
